style_bible.canonical_prompt: Original restrained illustrated utility-room horror. Kage-informed crafted surfaces, matte blue-charcoal framing, coherent cool upper-left light, a small warm practical accent, readable worn materials and silhouettes. No text, UI, baked movement or copied artwork.

style_bible.identity_rules: Same washer seam, hatch latch, gasket outline and loose plug in every shot. Preserve each original character face, silhouette, costume anchor and intended restrained expression. Extras remain readable anonymous groups.

scene_worlds.layout: Same utility-room geography: washer and loose lead in front; proposed observer A and attendant beside it; observer B near the entrance; six anonymous onlookers in a rear waiting area. Tighter shots crop people without moving the washer. Empty wall socket is a fixed readable architectural detail beside the loose-lead region; the separate plug stays physically clear of it.
scene_worlds.perspective: Fixed frontal/near-frontal views; no unsupported backside reveal.
scene_worlds.lighting: Soft cool upper-left light; stable warm practical reflection at the hatch edge.
scene_worlds.crop_safety: Keep the clue and needed face readable; do not reveal missing sides. A two-person crowd variant represents the two silhouettes in the tighter crop; the other four stay outside framing.

views.framing: Establish the same room, washer, empty socket and disconnected plug. Preserve fixed geography and leave the focal clue clear.

Reframe the same plate toward hatch and visible reactions; do not rebuild the room or interpret out-of-frame people as departures. Retain A, B and only the two onlookers declared in shot.cast; attendant and four other onlookers remain outside this shot.

Return attention to the same empty socket and disconnected lead; the established hatch direction and remaining reaction persist. Retain only A in shot.cast, with fear held and clue readable; all other people remain outside this shot. Washer body/hatch are outside this view, with their event state and sound source preserved; show no inserted plug.
